name: AUX_DRV
what_drives_it: 8-bit data latch to J2 aux connector (shared by aux coils and both ramp light tubes)

name: GI relay + aux strobes
what_drives_it: shadow byte 0x3c758; bit0 GI relay (0=on), bit4 CSTB = left ramp light tube, bit5 DSTB = right ramp light tube, bit6 ESTB = aux coils 33-40

name: flash bank select
what_drives_it: U42 A22-A25 bank register (corrected 2026-10-06, was listed as the diagnostic LED; see bus/cpu_board_interfaces.csv)

name: dedicated switches D1-D16
what_drives_it: IO tick phase 1 (corrected 2026-10-06, was listed as the switch strobe)

name: switch matrix column strobe
what_drives_it: IO tick, one column per 250 us tick (corrected 2026-10-06, was listed as the DMD page; the DMD page is 0x01100020)
